rationale: The workflow already implements the primary evidence-supported optimization for Java/Maven projects: dependency caching via actions/cache (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE). Both jobs cache ~/.m2/repository with keys based on pom.xml hashes, which matches the pattern shown in experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-a89d5fd8d30bc8cb-r2 (P-LIT-CONFIG-REUSE) and the literature pattern P-LIT-GHA-CACHE. No other patterns from the evidence apply: there is no matrix (P-LIT-FAIL-FAST), no scheduled triggers (P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE, P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE), no Bazel build (P-LIT-BAZEL-*), no test selection opportunity (P-LIT-SELECT, P-LIT-PRIORITIZE), and the workflow is manually triggered (workflow_dispatch) so skip/cancellation patterns are not relevant. The cache configuration uses actions/cache@v5 (current) and appropriate key/restore-keys. No further evidence-supported optimization is identified.
